# The "Open communications (VOTC)" decision: the snapshot, the player's leaders, open the app's list
country_event = {
	id = votc.2
	hide_window = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	immediate = {
		save_global_event_target_as = votc_e0
		set_variable = { which = votc_i value = 0 }
		log = "VOTC|BEGIN|stellaris|2|snapshot"
		log = "VOTC|META|campaign|0"
		log = "VOTC|META|date|[GetDate]"
		log = "VOTC|P|tag|E0"
		log = "VOTC|P|name|[This.GetName]"
		log = "VOTC|P|leader|[This.GetRulerName]"
		log = "VOTC|P|leader_title|[This.GetRulerTitle]"
		log = "VOTC|P|government|[This.GetGovernmentName]"
		log = "VOTC|P|species|[This.GetSpeciesName]"
		every_playable_country = {
			limit = { is_at_war_with = prev }
			log = "VOTC|P|war_with|[This.GetName]"
		}
		every_playable_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_same_value = prev }
				has_communications = prev
			}
			prev = { change_variable = { which = votc_i value = 1 } }
			# THIS = an empire, PREV = the player's country (its votc_i is this empire's slot)

				limit = { prev = { check_variable = { which = votc_i value = 1 } } }
				save_global_event_target_as = votc_e1

				if = { limit = { has_defensive_pact = prev } log = "VOTC|R|E29|defensive_pact|yes" }
				if = { limit = { has_non_aggression_pact = prev } log = "VOTC|R|E29|non_aggression_pact|yes" }
				if = { limit = { is_subject = yes overlord = { is_same_value = prev } } log = "VOTC|R|E29|subject|yes" }
				if = { limit = { prev = { is_subject = yes overlord = { is_same_value = prevprev } } } log = "VOTC|R|E29|overlord|yes" }
				if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > 99 } } log = "VOTC|R|E29|opinion|75" }
				else_if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > 24 } } log = "VOTC|R|E29|opinion|40" }
				else_if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > -25 } } log = "VOTC|R|E29|opinion|0" }
				else_if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > -100 } } log = "VOTC|R|E29|opinion|-40" }
				else = { log = "VOTC|R|E29|opinion|-75" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { prev = { check_variable = { which = votc_i value = 30 } } }
				save_global_event_target_as = votc_e30
				log = "VOTC|C|E30|name|[This.GetName]"
				log = "VOTC|C|E30|leader|[This.GetRulerName]"
				log = "VOTC|C|E30|leader_title|[This.GetRulerTitle]"
				log = "VOTC|C|E30|government|[This.GetGovernmentName]"
				log = "VOTC|C|E30|species|[This.GetSpeciesName]"
				every_playable_country = { limit = { is_at_war_with = prev } log = "VOTC|C|E30|war_with|[This.GetName]" }
				if = { limit = { is_at_war_with = prev } log = "VOTC|R|E30|war|yes" }
				if = { limit = { is_in_federation_with = prev } log = "VOTC|R|E30|ally|yes" }
				if = { limit = { has_defensive_pact = prev } log = "VOTC|R|E30|defensive_pact|yes" }
				if = { limit = { has_non_aggression_pact = prev } log = "VOTC|R|E30|non_aggression_pact|yes" }
				if = { limit = { is_subject = yes overlord = { is_same_value = prev } } log = "VOTC|R|E30|subject|yes" }
				if = { limit = { prev = { is_subject = yes overlord = { is_same_value = prevprev } } } log = "VOTC|R|E30|overlord|yes" }
				if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > 99 } } log = "VOTC|R|E30|opinion|75" }
				else_if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > 24 } } log = "VOTC|R|E30|opinion|40" }
				else_if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > -25 } } log = "VOTC|R|E30|opinion|0" }
				else_if = { limit = { opinion = { who = prev value > -100 } } log = "VOTC|R|E30|opinion|-40" }
				else = { log = "VOTC|R|E30|opinion|-75" }
			}
		}
		log = "VOTC|META|talk|pick"
		every_owned_leader = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes }
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|ruler|yes"
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|title|Ruler"
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader_class = commander }
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|title|Commander"
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader_class = official }
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|title|Official"
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader_class = scientist }
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|title|Scientist"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { gender = female }
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|gender|female"
			}
			else = {
				log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|gender|male"
			}
			log = "VOTC|CH|E0|[This.GetName]|species|[This.GetSpeciesName]"
		}
		log = "VOTC|END"
	}
}
